testcase.name: Scenario: Cycle drawing ribbon display by double-clicking its active tab: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:102:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cycle drawing ribbon display by double-clicking its active tab ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes ✔ And the Place Views tab shows its full command groups ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab ✔ Then the ribbon shows compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons ✔ And the drawing workspace has more vertical space ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again ✔ Then the ribbon shows the group titles in a narrow strip ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again ✔ Then the ribbon shows tabs without the group strip ✔ When the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again ✔ Then the full Place Views command groups are visible ✔ And the drawing document remains active
